title: Recommend result voice count editable + correct seed
summary: Voice pickers on recommend/records pages seed from Settings after hydration, remain editable per card. ScrollPicker uses scrollIntoView so values no longer stick at minimums (1, 0.8, 1, 1).
testFocus: Search → recommend result: voice pickers show Settings values (not 1/0.8/1/1), user can scroll to change. Records card same. Settings page pickers unchanged.
productionChecks: /recommend/:machineCode/result?id=… — voice pickers match settings and are scrollable
/records — expanded card voice pickers match settings and are scrollable

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main

asIs: Recommend result voice pickers show minimum values; read-only attempt blocked edits.
toBe: Seed from Settings, display correct values, user can edit per session/card.
